6.2.9.2.2 EEPROM driver
Detection Reported by the EEPROM controller (see EEPROM controller above). Reaction
 [SWS_Eep_00068] The job is aborted.
 [SWS_Eep_00068] The module state is set to MEMIF_IDLE, ready to accept new jobs. Report
 The error is reported to the DEM with the error code EEP_E_COMPARE_FAILED. Depending on the EEPROM Driver configuration:
 [SWS_Eep_00068] The error shall be polled by the EEPROM Abstraction with the function Eep_GetJobResult (job result set to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED).
 [SWS_Eep_00068] The error shall be reported to the EEPROM Abstraction by the callback function Fee_JobErrorNotification. Recovery N/A

 [SWS_NvM_00470] If there is use of ROM data during recovery the job result is set to NVM_REQ_RESTORED_FROM_ROM.

 If recovery actions fail, the job result is set to NVM_REQ_NOT_OK and the NVRAM manager reports NVM_E_REQ_FAILED to the DEM (see NVM API request failure). Recovery
